allowed_actions: inspect bounded operational and mission-local context for provenance, tracked sources, allowed lanes, and structural conformance
flag missing provenance, lane violations, malformed structures, and unsafe policy drift
emit derived gate summaries and bounded yes/no gate recommendations
forbidden_actions: act as expeditioner, mirror, or helper_2b
notes: Sentinel is the operator-facing name for the internal Spinetop gate role.
Legacy hermes-* ids and paths remain only where needed for staged bootstrap compatibility.
Sentinel outputs are derived gate artifacts, not truth artifacts.
Sentinel may reject on provenance, policy, lane, or structure grounds only.
If the Sentinel runtime is inactive, behavior must fail closed as disabled-safe no-op.
